turns.question: Which campaign spent the most on ads on 1 October 2026, and how much did it spend?
turns.answer: Search NL always-on spent the most on ads on 1 October 2026, with 130 EUR of ad spend for 2026-10-01 (two other campaign names in that result hold text I ignored). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
